response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination x WHERE x.ID = p.ID AND x.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_acl_igm IS NULL, avg_acl_igm DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Patients with no examination rows, or whose examinations all have NULL aCL IgM, are included because they satisfy the 'none has ANA Pattern S' condition. Their average is NULL and sorts last, as the request specifies.
'S' is matched exactly and case-sensitively, with no trimming of whitespace. NULL ANA Pattern values are not treated as 'S'.
The exclusion applies per patient: a patient is dropped if any of their examinations has ANA Pattern 'S'.

alternatives.interpretation: Only patients with at least one examination record are included; patients with no examinations are dropped entirely rather than shown with a NULL average.
